environment.description: Rails 7.0 application deployed on EC2 behind a basic NGINX reverse proxy. No additional security headers enforced at the proxy layer. The widget layout CSP meta tag is present but the application also serves responses with X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff only. No integrity verification on loaded scripts. The CDN (cdn.example.com) serves scripts over HTTPS but without any pinning or integrity checks. An attacker who compromises the CDN or performs DNS hijacking can serve arbitrary JavaScript through the theme_script_url parameter or by exploiting the Unicode normalization bypass to inject script tags via homoglyph characters (e.g., using U+FE64 SMALL LESS-THAN SIGN which normalizes differently).
